headline: European and Finnish quantum is scaling from lab to listed industry (IQM's Q3 2026 revenue +51%, backlog €102.5M), but revenues are still small and losses large.
outlook_reason: Order backlog is growing, Finnish seed and Series A rounds are landing, and EuroHPC and Horizon calls are open; the main risks are the EU's small share of private capital and an unconfirmed Quantum Act.

metrics.label: Share of quantum computing private capital going to European firms (vs ~50% US)

signals.title: IQM reports Q3 2026 results
signals.detail: Revenue about €8.9M (+51%), new orders €42.2M, backlog €102.5M, cash €260.4M. FY2026 guidance reaffirmed: revenue €42-47M, order intake €65-75M, weighted to Q4. A €127M non-cash listing charge is included in the reported result.

signals.title: Coherence Quantum (Espoo) raises €2.78M seed
signals.detail: Led by Lifeline Ventures. Cryogenic signalling and control for scaling quantum computers; the money funds an Espoo lab and first prototypes. The firm is a likely partner for Aalto cryogenic-electronics work, but I did not verify its Aalto link.

signals.title: QuantrolOx raises €12M Series A
signals.detail: Anglo-Finnish Oxford spinout, led by IW Capital with the EIC Fund and Transpose Capital. Qubit control software.

signals.title: Quantum Act status still unconfirmed
signals.detail: The act was planned for Q2 2026. Searches found only the consultation (Oct 2025) and legislative-train entry, with no confirmation of a formal proposal.
